thread:
Anika: quick heads-up — i'm about to open a docs PR to clarify region headers and SDK examples for city-level endpoints. want a quick sanity check
Josh: +1. can you include both hosted and private examples? customers get confused between `region` param vs `base_url` for private deployments.
Anika: plan is to show a hosted SDK snippet and a private curl example. thinking of demonstrating `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1` header and `base_url` usage.
Liam: i'd show `region` in the managed SDK and `base_url` for private. e.g.
```
# hosted
client = RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")
# private
client = RedwoodClient(base_url="https://private-<acct>.redwood.local")
```
Anika: perfect. i'll also add a short data residency note: "processing occurs in the selected region; control plane metadata may be routed to our control plane unless residency is enabled" — need legal signoff on phrasing.
Sara: legal reviewed a draft earlier. ok to say "processed in-region when residency is enabled" and avoid "stored permanently". prefer "retained according to the customer's configured retention policy". link to compliance page: https://redwood.com/docs/compliance/data-residency
Josh: tiny nit — include the `X-Api-Version: 2026-01-01` header in curl samples; we've asked customers to pin api-version.
Anika: good catch, adding that. also product asked to avoid acronyms in user-facing text — use "Asia Pacific (APAC)" instead of just "APAC".
Liam: i'm going to draft a small region->endpoint matrix in the doc to reduce support tickets: region code, marketing name, canonical endpoint host. will include examples for eu, us, apac.
Anika: sweet. i'll open the PR shortly and add reviewers @Josh @Liam. will post the link here.
Docs-bot: PR created #1234 by Anika: docs/l10n-region-examples — reviewers requested: Josh, Liam :sparkles:
Josh: reviewing now — left one inline about the sample timeout in the SDK snippet (should be 30s not 60s). :eyes:
Anika: addressing that now. thanks for the review.
Sara: approved the residency wording. :white_check_mark:
Liam: LGTM after the timeout fix.
Anika: merged. once it's live can someone sanity-check the quickstart example in staging?
Josh: i'll smoke-test the snippet against staging tonight and report back.
Anika: awesome, thanks everyone! :tada:
